title: ping_l2: test-isolation drift after TX fix (queue_stats -ECANCELED leak, udp LoRa-not-running)
description: Follow-up from 5fva.1. After 237dc35064 + 84908feee9: (1) test_queue_stats_accessor_lifecycle fails at its FIRST stats read with -125/ECANCELED — the destroy-retry pending latch from the preceding test_disable_retries_incomplete_queue_destruction leaks past its completed teardown; pre-fix it passed only because TX never really ran. (2) test_udp_payload_reaches_socket_after_l2_injection logs 'TX rejected (LoRa L2 not running)' — its TX attempt lands while L2 is stopped from prior teardown ordering. Both are test-order/state-isolation issues, not stack bugs: each reinit-cycling test must fully restore lora_l2 running + queue state (and clear retry latches) before returning, or tests need a per-test setUp barrier.
